name: Ming Guo
title: Chief Scientist and Co-founder
conviction_themes: ZK is bigger than blockchain — it is a universal interoperability and trust layer across all systems, not just crypto
Blockchains are siloed universes; ZK is the mechanism for sharing verifiable truths across fundamentally different systems
Trust is becoming programmable — it's no longer about who you are but what you can mathematically prove
MIPS-based zkVM design (vs. EVM-specific) is the correct architecture for universal verifiable computation beyond blockchain
Real-time proving is the unlock for true ZK-AI integration — enabling trust in model inference and decentralized AI
Bitcoin has become digital gold, not digital cash — its fixed supply incentivizes hoarding and prevents a self-sustaining economy
The DAC Economy (self-sustainable decentralized economy) — valuing community, individual sovereignty, and long-term sustainability over speculative gains — is the end goal of crypto
ZK enables an 'internet of trust' where participation is proved mathematically, not by identity or social class
previous_experiences: Co-founded Metis, an Ethereum L2 protocol, entering blockchain around 2017
Worked at a company developing the MIPS architecture (RISC chip industry)
Worked in computer graphics chip design
Did aerospace research on re-entry objects (self-described 'rocket scientist')
Co-founded ZKM (incubated out of MetisDAO Foundation), raised $5M Pre-A in November 2023 led by OKX Ventures
Co-founded Laz AI, focused on ZK-powered decentralized AI and socially-driven data generation
Pioneered zkMIPS / Ziren — open-source zkVM on MIPS32r2 ISA (133+ GitHub stars)
bio_text: Ming Guo is the Co-founder and Chief Scientist of ZKM, where he leads development of zkMIPS/Ziren — a universal zero-knowledge virtual machine built on the MIPS32r2 ISA, designed for verifiable computation far beyond blockchain. With a career spanning aerospace, computer graphics, chip architecture (MIPS), and blockchain (co-founding Metis in ~2017), Ming is a deeply philosophical engineer who frames ZK not merely as a scaling tool but as the foundation for an 'internet of trust' and a self-sustainable decentralized economy (DAC Economy). He recently co-founded Laz AI to explore the convergence of zero-knowledge proofs with artificial intelligence.
